verdict.rationale: GitHub is well covered as a launch surface: you can assign tasks to agents [docs-3], mention @copilot on pull requests [docs-32], launch work from GitHub [docs-8], and trigger automations when an issue is opened [docs-33]. Beyond GitHub, the only evidence is a vague claim that Copilot works in "project tools" and "chat apps" [docs-35], with no named Linear, Slack, or GitLab integration. Missing for 10: documented Slack integration for starting agent tasks, documented Linear integration, any GitLab support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
